task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for OBS-04 at src/design/obs-04-instance-timeline.md. Define GET /instances/:id/timeline end-to-end design including route contract, authorization model (any authenticated role), deterministic ascending chronological ordering, API-06 pagination semantics, and 404 behavior for missing instances. Specify timeline entry schema with required fields: event_type, timestamp, actor_display_name (or system fallback), description, and relevant context fields (task_id, node_id, event metadata). Design event-log replay/query strategy to include archived events (ES-07), actor display-name resolution flow (IDN-01), and behavior for automated/token-originated actions. Include rendering/description rules for key event families (instance lifecycle, task activation/completion, cancellations, errors) and ensure CANCELLED instances return complete history including INSTANCE_CANCELLED. Provide index/query and performance considerations, failure semantics, and a requirement-to-design traceability matrix mapping every OBS-04 acceptance criterion and edge case to modules/functions and test obligations. Design only; do not modify implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: All OBS-04 acceptance criteria and edge cases map to explicit design elements
Route contract, auth, pagination, ordering, and 404 semantics are concrete and testable
Timeline entry shape and human-readable description rules are fully specified
Archived-event inclusion and actor display-name fallback behavior are explicitly designed
Traceability matrix identifies module boundaries and verification hooks for implementation/testing

result.summary: Design artefact for OBS-04 instance timeline completed at src/design/obs-04-instance-timeline.md, including route/auth contract, ascending ordering, API-06 pagination semantics, timeline entry schema, actor display-name fallback, archived-event inclusion strategy, CANCELLED-instance history behavior, and full requirement-to-design traceability.
